:::{#def-wald-test}
#### Wald test

The **Wald test** of $H_0: \param_k = \param_{k,0}$
uses the test statistic

$$Z \eqdef \frac{\hparam_k - \param_{k,0}}{\HSE{\hparam_k}}$$

which, by @thm-dist-mle, has approximately a standard Gaussian distribution
under $H_0$ in large samples.
For $q$ constraints $H_0: \vparam_{(q)} = \vparam_{(q),0}$ on a $q \times 1$ subvector,
the Wald statistic is
$\tp{\paren{\hvparam_{(q)} - \vparam_{(q),0}}}\,\inv{\hat{V}_{(q)}}\,\paren{\hvparam_{(q)} - \vparam_{(q),0}}$,
where $\hat V_{(q)}$ is the corresponding $q \times q$ block of $\inv{\hat{\einf}}$;
it has approximately a $\chi^2_q$ distribution under $H_0$.
:::
